senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Uhsa, in Galilee; freq. the scene of rabbin. synods and enactments during and after the Hadrianic persecutions.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 50a:11">Keth. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>מרה דשמעתא דא׳</he> master of the traditions of U. (in whose name they are quoted). [<cite ref="Ketubot 50a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>קאי באוכלוסא דא׳</he>, read <he>בהילכתא</he> engaged in teaching the laws passed at U.] <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 31b">R. Hash. 31ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
